## Intent

Why this change exists. Link the ticket (`Closes ABC-1`).

## Changed / not changed

- Changed:
- Not changed (out of scope, left alone on purpose):

## Risks

Tick every box that applies. A change with none of these says "none" here.

- [ ] Touches auth or permissions
- [ ] Touches money or payments
- [ ] Touches user data
- [ ] Includes a migration or deletes data
- [ ] Touches infra, CI or secrets
- [ ] Removes, skips or weakens a test, check or threshold

## How to revert

Per ticked box: what can go wrong and how to roll back. Skip when nothing is ticked.

## Agreed decisions

Optional. When the work was discussed first, one box per decision, ticked once the diff does it:

- [ ] 

## Verified

Proof per claim: the test that fails without the change, pasted command output in a fenced block, or a screenshot. Docs-only or config-only: say so. "Tests pass" and "verified manually" are not proof; write "not run" for anything skipped. Last line: what these checks would miss.

## Unresolved questions

Terse bullets, or "none".
